coverage_caveat: coverage_of_recording is the span between a person's first and last sighting divided by the recording length. It is NOT a guarantee they were watched throughout that span -- tracking breaks and re-identification does not exist, so one physical person may appear as several tracks.
note: Every person observed is profiled, whether or not anything notable happened to them. A person's departure figures are measured against their own resting orientation, so they are comparable within that person over time and not between people.
